samples.question: The upper row of this image shows four colored plates - one red, one blue, one green and one orange - and the lower row shows those same four plates again, this time all gray. Every plate carries some black dots. A gray plate and a colored plate are the same plate exactly when they carry the same number of black dots, and the four plates all carry different numbers of dots, so this pairing is unique. Between the rows a plate keeps its number of dots but may change its left-to-right position, its size, its dot positions and its dot size, so nothing except the dot count links the rows. Exactly one gray plate in the lower row is surrounded by a black rectangular frame. What color is that framed plate in the upper row? Answer red, blue, green, or orange.
